name: linear-synthetic
description: Linear bandit: 10 instances (1000 actions and theta uniform on the unit sphere of R^20, noise 0.1), 2 runs each. LinUCB and ConfidenceBall1 against random projections (LinUCB_RP, CBRAP), sketches (SOFUL, CBSCFD) and LinTS. Theoretical defaults.

notices.title: Default hyperparameters
notices.text: LinUCB, ConfidenceBall1, LinUCB_RP, CBRAP, SOFUL, CBSCFD and 1 more keep the values of their papers (alpha=1: theoretical confidence bounds). These values are safe in theory but often explore too much in practice. To fit them to this problem, run a grid search (param_grid=True, or "param_grid": true in a config file) or set them, e.g. LinUCB(alpha=0.1).

notices.title: Not stored
notices.text: Pseudo-regret (track "pseudo_regret"); sketch_error over time (track "clusters"); action of every step (track "actions"); peak memory (measure_memory=True). The dashboard and the figures cannot show what is not stored; the brackets say how to store it (in a config file: "track": [...] or "measure_memory": true in "experiment").

notices.title: Curves thinned
notices.text: Curves are stored every 15 steps (log_interval=15) and at the last step.

notices.title: Parallel runs
notices.text: With n_jobs=4, each process uses one BLAS thread: compare CPU times only between runs with the same n_jobs.
